notes_blind_original: CODECHECK/AGILE report: only figures and Table 5 were assessed, and the reviewer obtained updated code via communication with the authors to fix 'missing columns in GMHWG CSV' / 'Sum_GM_Group2'. Static check of the pinned v1 script: it parses in R (419 expressions), but GMHWG is never assigned and is first used at line 771. SUS_ScoresGroup2 is used at line 777 before its assignment at line 1079. Figshare v2 (2023-02-28, adds README) also never creates GMHWG, so the fix is not on Figshare in either version. C3/C4 code does not depend on GMHWG and could be run interactively line by line, but the sourced script dies first and no one reported values. That is why I used P0 not_checkable rather than leaving them unassessed. Minor claim-list nit: the paper labels the between-group tests 'Wilcoxon signed-rank test', but the code runs unpaired (rank-sum) tests. The claim text ('rank-sum W') is correct.
